text:
alex_dev: kicking off canary rollout for v1.9.3 now. enabling feature flag fastpath_v2 at 5% across us-east. will monitor for 10m.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by alex_dev — rollout id rl-20240622-17. canary targets 5% traffic.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — Canary error_rate for model-infer-service > 2.5% (5m window). threshold crossed at +3m.

sasha_oncall: seeing 502/504s on canary nodes, starting to tail logs. ps — no extra CPU, but upstream grpc timeouts.

marta_obs: trying to find the canary dashboard — the usual panel for model-level p50/p95 isn't showing the new metric name (inference.request_latency_by_model). link to dashboard returns 404 for panel id.

irene_sre: tag me. if dashboards are missing we might be flying blind. can we confirm alerts are wired to the right metric?

alex_dev: on it. my change renamed the metric in telemetry to inference.request_latency.p50_by_model — looks like the dashboard expected the old key. I didn't add a compatibility mapping, my bad.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook suggestion: for rollout-related 5xx spike -> (1) reduce rollout percentage, (2) kill-feature-flag, (3) collect sample request ids. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollout-failure

sasha_oncall: reducing canary to 0% now (rolling back traffic).

deploy-bot: Rollout traffic set to 0% for rollout id rl-20240622-17.

alex_dev: trying fast kill now. curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/fastpath_v2/kill" -H 'Authorization: Bearer XXX' && echo "killed"

alex_dev: response: {"status":"ok","flag_state":"killed"}

incident-bot: :information_source: Canary rollback detected for rl-20240622-17. Error rate returning to baseline. SLO delta: 0.8% additional error budget used in the last 10m.

sam_product: quick question — any customer-visible impact? did any prod tenants see errors or retries?

sasha_oncall: searching request logs for 5xx during 15:12-15:30 UTC. found ~120 unique customer request ids across 9 tenants, highest impact on tenant: acme-marketing (approx 40 errors, mostly retries).

irene_sre: noted. guessing retries bumped latency more than outright failures for others. can someone capture sample traces? we need to see whether it was grpc timeouts (upstream) or service side rejects.

sasha_oncall: sample trace (sanitized):
```
TraceID: 8a1f...
span: model-infer-service.handle_request -> duration 210ms -> upstream grpc call took 180ms -> upstream error: DeadlineExceeded
```

marta_obs: tying this back to missing telemetry: dashboards used the old metric; the alert rules still referenced error_rate_by_canary which is fine, but the latency panel was missing so we didn't notice p95 growth earlier. that's an observability gap.

alex_dev: sorry team. I should've added a compatibility alias when renaming metrics.

irene_sre: for immediate mitigation we did the right thing (reduce traffic + kill flag). going forward: open a follow-up to ensure telemetry renames include dashboard/alert migration checklist.

ops-runbook-bot: Suggested follow-ups added to incident summary template.

sam_product: flagging customer comms for acme-marketing — ops should own a brief explain + apology if SLA-breach threshold reached.

sasha_oncall: working with logs to quantify SLA exposure. prelim numbers: acme-marketing saw 99.1% success for the 18-minute window, SLA is 99.9% so we might need to notify.

alex_dev: creating postmortem PR and a migration checklist. linking it here when done.

irene_sre: handing on-call to sasha_oncall for the next 30m while I go run the postmortem template. sasha, let me know if you need escalation.

sasha_oncall: ack — taking over. I'll finish SLA calc and collect traces + screenshots.

marta_obs: created ticket OBS-3124: "Telemetry rename caused dashboard gap during rollout; missing p95 panel -> monitor alert misvisibility". Assigned to alex_dev, priority P2.

sam_product: for customer impact: I'll draft a short note for acme-marketing, will share in #customer-commms for review.

irene_sre: quick retro items: (1) metric rename checklist (alerts + dashboards), (2) pre-rollout telemetry smoke test (small script to assert panels & alerts), (3) consider alerting on sudden metric disappearance.

alex_dev: agree. will add these to the PR and follow up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved: immediate mitigation applied (flag kill + traffic rollback). Open tickets: OBS-3124, PM-789 (postmortem PR).

sasha_oncall: closing thread for active on-call — will update OBS-3124 with SLA calc and traces by EOD.

ops-runbook-bot: If further escalation required runbook command: `/runbook escalate oncall`

alex_dev: thanks all — sorry for the noise. learned a lot here.
